text_block_list.text:
One evening, while walking through
the shopping district with Winning Ticket—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh!
Look at this, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear?!
We're going on a trip! And to a hot spring, no less!!
choice_data_list: Do you want to go, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"We get to eat, have fun, and soak in the hot springs, you know?!
Plus, our friendship will deepen even more along the way!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This is youth at its absoluuute finest!!
Three cheers for hot springs~~~!!
choice_data_list: Hold your horses, hold your horses!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
You can't win the grand prize without spinning the wheel, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Little lady, got a lottery ticket on ya?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's the one from the register, right?
Oh, I totally get it~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
Let's spin it together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If we both pour our fighting spirit into it,
there's no doubt we'll hit the grand prize!!

With a shout in unison, the two spun the lottery wheel.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeeek!!!
Did we really win the grand priiiiize!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer... the grand prize...? The grand prize...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAHN!
I'b zo haaaaaapppyyyyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Seeing you this happy
makes me happy too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're such a nice guy, misteeer!!
Trainer and I will be sure to put this ticket to good use!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! We won the grand prize because
we both pumped ourselves up for it, right?
choice_data_list: Then I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"When should I go, I wonder~?
If I'm going, might as well be when it's most fun—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"THAAAT'S ITTT!!
Let's go once the Twinkle Series is over!
It'll be an afterparty, an afterparty!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring after a heated battle!!
That's gotta feel absolutely amazing~!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'm looking forward to it
Got it, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay--!!
I'm gonna win like crazy for that hot spring trip--!!
And so, I ended up holding onto the hot springs ticket for Winning Ticket for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Grand prize Carrot Hamburg Steak!!??

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
You girls sure are funny~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
It's not quite the grand prize, but this is good stuff too, you know?
It's got a rich flavor even certified gourmets praise!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoaaah... looks so yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
I'm gonna try making it today right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Grill it whoosh over a piping hot flame,
pour on heaps of oil, and splash the sauce on swooshâ
choice_data_list: H-Hey, want me to help with cooking?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to eat some too, Trainer?
Sure, go right ahead~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria kitchen is still open, right?!
Hurry, go go before it closes!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOH~~~~~!!
Both me and the hamburger steak are blazing hot~!
Helping out so it wouldn't burn to a crisp, the two of them ate the finished Salisbury steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~!
What an amazing carrot!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this the grand prize?!
Are you sure I can take all this for 2nd place?!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
They're all yours, little ladies.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... Amazing!
Even after eating them every day for a week, there's still more left!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Though,
there might be too much for me to finish all of it—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know!
I'll give half to you too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If we share it, the joy is doubled!
And our friendship will burn even hotter, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We got our hands on it...
A bond that beats any grand prize...!!!
I accepted half of a carrot from Winning Ticket, who was bawling tears of emotion.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just one carrot...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"No!
It's not unfortunate AT AAAAALL!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because this carrot was won with Trainer's cheers
and my own luck...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In other words!!
It is proof of our burning, fiery friendship!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh!!
I'm so moveddddd~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Along with how I feel right now, I'll preserve this carrot forever—
choice_data_list: No, because it'll only make things worse.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No wayyy!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: To think I can't even keep a keepsake of our memories together, Trainer... Waaah~~!!
choice_data_list: Because the memories will remain if we eat together...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: T-THAT'S ITTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And with that, here's your half!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmm, so goood!!

After savoring the taste of the carrot together,
the two of them headed back side by side.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
O-One more time! Let me draw one more time~!!
I'll win the grand prize this time for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I can't let you draw without a lottery ticket~

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAHN!
I'b zo fruddradeeeed~~~~!!
I handed the prize tissues to a bawling Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... *sniff*.
The tissues are so soft...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
These tissues boast an angelic touch, after all.
They're super fluffy and have incredible healing power!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*,
just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“But... but I still
wanted the grand priiiiize, waaaahhhhh!!”

Even with the softness of tissues,
Winning Ticket's frustration did not subside for quite a while.
